tonight.headline: Up after Thursday; nothing left to set
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson (protocol, two DNPs) and George Pickens (hamstring, limited all week) are both doubtful-to-shaky on your bench; Tuten's 8.9 came in a blowout that handed the second half to Abdullah.

Bloodsports lead 18.9 to 10.88: the Jaguars D/ST scored 10 against the same Ravens offence that gave Jackrabbits Henry 5.6 and Flowers 5.3. ESPN projects 127.1 to 107.5, a 61% chance. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Jackrabbits still have Bijan Robinson, Ashton Jeanty (at San Francisco, SF -10), Burrow and McMillan to play; their tight end Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) was added to Cleveland's report as limited Thursday (Yahoo/Browns Wire 6 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Bloodsports starter is ruled out Friday or inactive Sunday — then this brief's 'nothing to do' is wrong and the bench decides.

roster.footnote: Rows show the lineup as set at the 12:50Z snapshot. Tuten (FLEX, 8.9) and the Jaguars D/ST (10) played Thursday and are locked. Grades: rank in fantasy points allowed to the position, 1 = toughest — StatChasers wks 1-8, upd. 4 Nov (half-PPR, 12% 2025 blend; ±1 rank). K and D/ST not graded.
